scope: The 40 irreducible components meeting the toric log-symplectic locus; not a full classification of Pois(P4).

conventions.P_r: a path with r vertices; P_1 is an isolated vertex
conventions.period_coordinates: b12,b13,b14,b23,b24,b34; the remaining entries are determined by skew symmetry and zero row sums
conventions.component_dimension: The affine Poisson space includes scaling, the projective space divides by scaling; neither divides by PGL(5).
conventions.dimension_derivation: At a toric point the PGL(5) orbit has dimension 20. A stratum of periods has dimension s and a smoothing graph with e edges has e smoothing parameters. Thus the affine component dimension is 20+s+e, projective dimension 19+s+e.
